facts.fact: Everett/Jody/Brooks 把 Ashton 夹在中间护送进 Tell's Tavern，吓退所有打量她的人。
facts.anchor: My brother stands directly behind me, flanked on either side by Jody and Brooks.

facts.fact: Jody 冲 Henry Duquette Jr. 皱眉瞪视，对方挥手僵在半空垂下。
facts.anchor: Jody continues to frown at Henry Duquette Jr. a few tables away. Henry’s friendly finger wave stalls mid-air and his hand slowly drops into his lap.

facts.fact: Jody 花二十分钟带回四瓶酒；Brooks 抽中下签当指定司机，拿汽水。
facts.anchor: It takes Jody a full twenty minutes to return, hands full with four bottles.

facts.fact: Cooper 给独坐的 Ross Scully 递水，他点头道谢。
facts.anchor: Cooper slides a glass of water over to him and he accepts it with a single nod of thanks, tucking it beside the whiskey

facts.fact: 闪回：Everett 来电支使她去查看六号围场，说 Big John 通报有门开着。
facts.anchor: “Hey kiddo, can you head out and check the sixth paddock? I think there’s a gate open, Big John just called. He’s way past it now.”

facts.fact: 恶作剧：Brooks/Jody 在她 ATV 座垫下藏发声器，Everett 举手机拍摄。
facts.anchor: Everett is filming on his cell phone as Brooks and Jody laugh so hard they’re doubled over, tears streaming down all three of their faces.

facts.fact: 她骂 Brooks 是恶魔，踩死油门扬尘而去。
facts.anchor: I yell, pressing my foot as hard as I can on the gas pedal and spinning the wheels, kicking up plenty of dirt as I tear away in the direction of home

facts.fact: 她的「反男人」立场只撑七天，就在 Farrow 电影院爱上爆米花摊男孩。
facts.anchor: My anti-men stance lasted all of seven days, because after that, I went to the movie theater in Farrow with some girls from my math class

facts.fact: Brooks 抽中下签当指定司机，她调侃攻守易位。
facts.anchor: Brooks drew the short straw as tonight’s designated driver.
